description: StaticFlux error catalog, generated by `sf errors`. Look codes up here instead of guessing; do not edit by hand.

errors.summary: No element could be focused for the route change or trap.
errors.fix: Render a `<main>` with an `<h1>`, mark the target with `data-sf-route-focus`, or pass `target` explicitly.

errors.summary: Two shortcuts bind the same key combination in the same scope.
errors.fix: Change one combo, or move one shortcut into a narrower scope (a child scope may shadow its parent).

errors.summary: A shortcut key combination is malformed.
errors.fix: Use `Modifier+Key` with modifiers in the order Mod, Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta and a key such as `K`, `Enter`, `ArrowUp`, `F2` or `/`.

errors.summary: No DOM document is available in this environment.
errors.fix: Focus and announcements need a document; in workers or headless hosts use the no-op behaviour or provide `A11yEnvironment.document`.

errors.summary: An advisor did not answer within its time box.
errors.fix: Expected under load; the deterministic default was used. Move the point to a slower latency class only with a reason.

errors.summary: An advisor returned no usable probability mass over the declared options.
errors.fix: Return finite, non-negative probabilities keyed by the decision point options; unknown options are ignored.

errors.summary: The statistical advisor has too little history for this question.
errors.fix: Expected for new users; the default heuristic answers until enough observations exist.

errors.summary: Advisor history could not be read or written.
errors.fix: History is a performance hint only; the advisor restarts empty. Check the storage port (user-data slice) for the cause.

errors.summary: Stored advisor history has an unknown shape or version.
errors.fix: The history was reset to empty. Bump the snapshot version and add a migration when changing the stored shape.

errors.summary: The advisor was asked about a decision point it does not support.
errors.fix: Check `advisor.supports(point)` before calling; the advisor service does this automatically.

errors.summary: No model is available for this AI task on this device/provider.
errors.fix: Gate the feature on the AI availability facts (`provider.facts`); AI is never on the critical path, so degrade to the non-AI path.

errors.summary: Starting the model download needs a user gesture.
errors.fix: Call `provider.prepare(task)` from a click/keypress handler (Chrome requires user activation when availability is `downloadable`).

errors.summary: The decision model returned probabilities that do not fit the closed option set.
errors.fix: Return one finite, non-negative probability per option (array in option order, or a record keyed by option); unknown options are ignored.

errors.summary: The AI provider failed while running the request.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Treat AI as optional: show the non-AI fallback and let the user retry.

errors.summary: The model output could not be parsed into the expected shape.
errors.fix: Constrain the output (JSON schema / responseConstraint) or retry; never trust free-form model output as structured data.

errors.summary: The app is paused; only the resume path may execute (I-1).
errors.fix: Wait with `supervisor.whenRunnable(request, signal)`, or check `supervisor.assertRunnable()` before starting work.

errors.summary: The app command is not allowed in the current app state.
errors.fix: Check `supervisor.can(command)` first; docs/LIFECYCLES.md §1 lists the commands allowed per state.

errors.summary: A feature requested an app-wide command and the command policy denied it.
errors.fix: Features only *request* commands; bind `CommandPolicyToken` in the shell to change what is allowed.

errors.summary: A subsystem failed more often than its restart intensity allows and was given up.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` and the restart history in devtools; fix the failure or raise `restart.maxRestarts` with a reason.

errors.summary: The subsystem dependency graph is invalid (duplicate id, unknown dependency, cycle, or critical → non-critical edge).
errors.fix: Give every subsystem a unique id, declare only registered ids in `dependsOn`, and keep critical subsystems depending on critical ones only.

errors.summary: The app could not reach core-ready (a critical unit or critical subsystem failed).
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Only units that truly block the first frame should be `critical`; make the rest lazy.

errors.summary: The app is shutting down or terminated.
errors.fix: Expected after shutdown. Do not keep handles to the supervisor beyond app lifetime.

errors.summary: A task exceeded its timeout.
errors.fix: Make the task cheaper, stream partial results, or raise the timeout with a documented reason.

errors.summary: The circuit breaker is open; the call was not attempted.
errors.fix: The dependency is failing repeatedly. Show degraded UI and let the breaker half-open after its reset window.

errors.summary: The operation needs an authenticated session, but the session is not authenticated.
errors.fix: Check `session.isAuthenticated` (or wait with `session.whenSettled()`) before calling; route through the login flow when the user is a guest.

errors.summary: The backend answered 401 Unauthorized.
errors.fix: The session or token is no longer valid. The session store refreshes once (single-flight); if that fails the session expires and the user must log in.

errors.summary: The backend answered 403 Forbidden.
errors.fix: Feed the revocation into gate facts (R6.14). Do not retry; show the denied state.

errors.summary: An auth request failed at the network level.
errors.fix: Usually transient (offline, DNS, CORS). The session keeps its last known state; retry later.

errors.summary: The auth backend answered with a 5xx status.
errors.fix: Transient: retry with backoff. Do not log the user out because of a 5xx.

errors.summary: An auth endpoint returned a body that does not match the expected shape.
errors.fix: Check the endpoint contract (session JSON / token response) or pass a custom `parseSession` to the provider.

errors.summary: The OAuth callback `state` does not match any pending login started by this browser.
errors.fix: Possible CSRF or a stale/duplicated callback tab. Start a new login; never accept a callback without a matching state.

errors.summary: The authorization server returned an error to the callback (e.g. access_denied).
errors.fix: Show the error to the user and offer to retry login. `details.error` holds the OAuth error code.

errors.summary: The identity provider cannot perform this operation in this environment.
errors.fix: Feature-detect first (e.g. `isPasskeySupported()`), or bind a different provider for this platform/host mode.

errors.summary: The session cannot be refreshed (no refresh capability or no refresh token).
errors.fix: The user must log in again. For oidc-pkce the refresh token lives only in memory and is lost on reload by design.

errors.summary: The session has expired.
errors.fix: Call `session.login()` to re-authenticate; the deep-link intent is kept via `returnTo`.

errors.summary: The session was revoked (server push, 403, or another tab).
errors.fix: Log in again. Revocation is final for this session; do not retry the failed call.

errors.summary: WebCrypto (crypto.subtle / getRandomValues) is not available.
errors.fix: PKCE requires a secure context (https or localhost). Use the bff-cookie provider where WebCrypto is unavailable.

errors.summary: The embedding host bridge failed or is not present.
errors.fix: Check host detection (window.openai / MCP Apps bridge). In embedded mode the host owns OAuth; the widget never holds tokens.

errors.summary: The auth backend answered 429 Too Many Requests.
errors.fix: Back off; the single-flight refresh should prevent bursts — check for refresh loops.

errors.summary: The passkey ceremony was cancelled or not allowed by the user agent.
errors.fix: Expected when the user dismisses the prompt. Offer another login method; do not retry automatically.

errors.summary: A login is already in progress.
errors.fix: Await the pending login (or `session.whenSettled()`) instead of starting another.

errors.summary: No capability with this id is declared.
errors.fix: Declare it with `registry.declare(capability)` or a `capabilityDeclarationUnit(capability)`; agents should list tools before calling them.

errors.summary: A value does not match the capability schema.
errors.fix: Fix the caller (see `details.issues`, one entry per problem). Agent input is untrusted; never loosen the schema to make a bad call pass.

errors.summary: The policy decision denied this capability for this subject.
errors.fix: Show the reason (`details.reason`: login, upgrade, forbidden, unavailable, quota, rate) instead of retrying. Client gating is UX — the server re-checks.

errors.summary: The user declined (or could not be asked) to confirm this capability call.
errors.fix: Expected for destructive agent actions the user rejected. Do not retry automatically; let the user or agent ask again.

errors.summary: The call needs confirmation but no confirmation port is bound.
errors.fix: Bind a `CapabilityConfirmPortToken` unit (e.g. a messaging confirm dialog). The default port fails closed on purpose.

errors.summary: The capability is declared but no implementation is registered.
errors.fix: Register one with `registry.provide(implementation, scope)` when the owning feature activates, or set `feature` on the declaration so invoke can activate it.

errors.summary: A capability implementation returned a value that does not match its output schema.
errors.fix: Fix the implementation (see `details.issues`). The output schema is the contract agents rely on.

errors.summary: The capability's owning feature could not be activated.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (chunk load, gating, init failure). The feature-activation port decides how features load.

errors.summary: Two different declarations (or two live implementations) use the same capability id.
errors.fix: Capability ids are namespaced (`feature/action`) and must be unique; dispose the previous registration scope first.

errors.summary: A capability implementation threw instead of returning a Result.
errors.fix: Return `err(...)` with a typed SfError from the implementation; see `cause`.

errors.summary: The policy decision requires a signed-in user for this capability.
errors.fix: Offer sign-in (the intent survives via handoff); do not retry until the session changes.

errors.summary: The policy decision denied this capability because a quota/credit meter is exhausted.
errors.fix: Surface the low-balance / upsell surface; the meter balance is server-authoritative.

errors.summary: The policy decision denied this capability because a rate limit was hit.
errors.fix: Back off and retry later (`details.meta` may carry a retry hint).

errors.summary: The capability is unavailable for the current platform, mode or host.
errors.fix: Hide or disable the trigger; the decision changes reactively when the facts change.

errors.summary: A layer supplied a value that does not match the flag schema.
errors.fix: Fix the value in the layer (remote config, storage, URL) or the flag schema; the resolver falls through to lower layers meanwhile.

errors.summary: Two different flag declarations use the same key.
errors.fix: Declare each flag once in its owner package contracts file and import that declaration everywhere.

errors.summary: A flag provider failed to initialize (or timed out).
errors.fix: Values from this provider are skipped; lower layers and package defaults apply. Check the provider endpoint/credentials.

errors.summary: A flag provider failed to reconcile a new evaluation context.
errors.fix: The provider keeps serving its last cached values; check the provider and retry on the next context change.

errors.summary: A flag-driven variant binding was evaluated before the flag resolver was attached.
errors.fix: Register `flagBinder.unit` (critical) so the binder attaches during boot; until then flags read their package default.

errors.summary: A flag provider returned an error while evaluating a flag.
errors.fix: Inspect `details.errorCode`; the resolver falls through to lower layers. Fix the flag in the provider or its targeting rules.

errors.summary: A flag key is not declared.
errors.fix: Use a key from a `defineFlag` declaration (register its package flags via `flagDefinitionUnits`).

errors.summary: Loading remote flag values failed.
errors.fix: The remote layer keeps its previous values (or none); lower layers apply. Check the endpoint and retry policy.

errors.summary: An unexpected non-StaticFlux error was thrown.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`; wrap the throwing call with `attempt()` and return a typed error instead.

errors.summary: A resource was registered on, or used from, a disposed scope.
errors.fix: Check `scope.disposed` before late async continuations, or pass `scope.signal` so the work is aborted instead.

errors.summary: The operation was aborted.
errors.fix: Usually expected (navigation, scope disposal). Do not retry aborted work.

errors.summary: The operation timed out.
errors.fix: Raise the timeout only with a reason; prefer making the operation cheaper or cancellable.

errors.summary: An event was sent that is not valid in the current state.
errors.fix: Check `machine.can(event)` first, or consult docs/LIFECYCLES.md for the valid transitions of this machine.

errors.summary: A response arrived for an older app epoch and was discarded (I-10).
errors.fix: Expected after refresh/session change. Do not retry; active resources refetch automatically in the new epoch.

errors.summary: The request was rejected because the transport is paused.
errors.fix: Mark read endpoints `idempotent: true` (they queue by default), or retry the mutation explicitly after resume.

errors.summary: The selected transport does not support this operation (request vs stream).
errors.fix: Route the endpoint to a transport that supports it via `endpoint.transport`, e.g. SSE/WebSocket for streams.

errors.summary: The mock transport has no route for this endpoint.
errors.fix: Register a handler with `mock.route(endpoint, handler)` (or `mock.stream`) before calling it.

errors.summary: The response body could not be decoded or did not match the endpoint schema.
errors.fix: Check the backend contract; the endpoint `response`/`chunk` schema describes what the client expects.

errors.summary: No transport is bound for the endpoint's transport slot.
errors.fix: Pass the slot in `createDataClient({ transports: [[slot, transport]] })` or bind a unit for it.

errors.summary: The transport's browser API (EventSource, WebSocket, fetch) is not available here.
errors.fix: Feature-detected: inject the constructor/factory, or bind a different transport for this slot.

errors.summary: The request failed at the network level (offline, DNS, CORS, connection reset).
errors.fix: Usually transient; the client retries idempotent requests. Show offline UI if it persists.

errors.summary: The server or gateway timed out (408/504).
errors.fix: Retried automatically for idempotent requests; consider streaming or paging large responses.

errors.summary: The server rejected the credentials (401).
errors.fix: Let the auth package refresh the session; requests are re-issued after the epoch bump.

errors.summary: The server refused the request (403).
errors.fix: The user lacks the permission server-side; client gating is UX only. Show an upsell/denied surface.

errors.summary: The resource does not exist (404/410).
errors.fix: Show an empty/not-found state; do not retry.

errors.summary: The server rejected the request as invalid (400/422).
errors.fix: Validate input with the endpoint schema before sending; inspect `details.body` for the server message.

errors.summary: The server reported a conflict (409/412).
errors.fix: Refetch and rebase the change, or surface a conflict resolver.

errors.summary: The server is unavailable (5xx).
errors.fix: Transient; retried for idempotent requests and counted by the endpoint circuit breaker.

errors.summary: The server rate-limited the request (429).
errors.fix: Back off; `details.retryAfterMs` carries the server hint when present.

errors.summary: The server returned an unexpected status.
errors.fix: Inspect `details.status`; map new statuses in `errorForStatus` if they are part of the contract.

errors.summary: The batch loader returned no result for a requested key.
errors.fix: A batch function must return one entry per key, in the same order as `keys` (DataLoader contract).

errors.summary: The resource handle was disposed.
errors.fix: Expected when the owning scope ends; do not use a handle after disposal (I-12).

errors.summary: A value does not match its schema.
errors.fix: Fix the producer; `details.path` and `details.expected` say where and what was expected.

errors.summary: A value is not structured-clone-safe (functions, class instances, DOM nodes, proxies).
errors.fix: Store plain data only (objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null). Keep behaviour in actions.

errors.summary: The intent names an action the store does not declare.
errors.fix: Intents must use names from the store definition `actions`; check the storeId and the replica/owner versions.

errors.summary: A patch message does not follow the replica's current version (gap or duplicate).
errors.fix: Request a fresh snapshot from the owner (`owner.getSnapshot()` / `patchesSince`), then resume applying patches.

errors.summary: A patch message belongs to a different epoch than the replica.
errors.fix: Resnapshot: replicas follow the owner's epoch only through a snapshot.

errors.summary: A snapshot or patch has a different store schema version.
errors.fix: Owner and replica must run the same store definition version; reload the stale side or migrate the snapshot.

errors.summary: A store action threw; its changes were rolled back.
errors.fix: Actions must be synchronous, deterministic and only touch the draft. Inspect `cause`.

errors.summary: A store draft was used after its action finished.
errors.fix: Do not keep references to `draft` objects; perform all changes inside the action body.

errors.summary: A patch operation is not applicable to the current state.
errors.fix: Patches must be applied in version order to the state they were recorded against.

errors.summary: The requested version is older than the owner's patch ring buffer.
errors.fix: Send a full snapshot instead (`getSnapshot()`).

errors.summary: Two different slice definitions use the same key.
errors.fix: Slice keys are namespaced per feature (`feature/name`); rename one, or import the single shared definition.

errors.summary: A persisted slice could not be migrated; defaults were used instead.
errors.fix: Add or fix the migration for `details.from` → `details.to`. The stored value is left untouched until the next write.

errors.summary: The slice value exceeds its storage budget; the write was rejected.
errors.fix: Store less (ids instead of objects, trim history) or raise `budgetBytes` with a documented reason.

errors.summary: The slice is not ready for this operation.
errors.fix: Await `slice.whenReady()` before writing; check `slice.state`.

errors.summary: The user-data storage backend failed.
errors.fix: Values stay in memory and are retried on the next flush. Check quota/private-mode restrictions.

errors.summary: The requested storage backend is not available in this environment.
errors.fix: Feature-detected (e.g. Safari private mode, embedded webviews). Fall back to the memory backend.

errors.summary: Remote sync of user-data slices failed; changes stay queued locally.
errors.fix: Offline-first: nothing to do; the next flush or `sync()` retries.

errors.summary: No unit provides the requested token in this injector chain.
errors.fix: Register a unit that `provides` this token, or check that the feature module providing it is loaded.

errors.summary: A longer-lived unit depends on a shorter-lived unit.
errors.fix: Lower the consumer scope, raise the dependency scope, or pass the shorter-lived value as an argument instead.

errors.summary: A required dependency failed, so this unit cannot become ready.
errors.fix: Fix the failing dependency (see `cause`), or make it a lazy dependency if this unit can work without it.

errors.summary: Required dependencies form a cycle.
errors.fix: Break the cycle by making one edge lazy or functional, or extract the shared part into its own unit.

errors.summary: A unit's create() threw.
errors.fix: create() must be synchronous and side-effect free; move fallible work to init() and return a Result.

errors.summary: No injector of the unit's scope level exists in the requesting chain.
errors.fix: Resolve from an injector at (or below) the unit scope, e.g. a feature-scoped unit from a feature injector.

errors.summary: A unit was registered in an injector shorter-lived than its own scope.
errors.fix: Register app/session units at the app/session injector; feature modules may only register feature-or-shorter units.

errors.summary: A unit's init() failed.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Add a `retry` policy for transient failures, or surface degraded UI via the failed state.

errors.summary: The injector (scope) was disposed.
errors.fix: Expected during navigation/logout. Do not retain handles beyond their scope.

errors.summary: The component is not registered with this document engine.
errors.fix: Pass the component definition in `createDocumentEngine({ components: [...] })` (on every peer and worker).

errors.summary: The entity does not exist (never created, or deleted).
errors.fix: Check `engine.has(entity)` first; a concurrent peer may have deleted it — treat this as a normal outcome.

errors.summary: A component value does not match its schema (unknown field or wrong type).
errors.fix: Use the field names and types declared in `defineComponent(id, schema)`.

errors.summary: A text edit is out of range or targets a non-text component.
errors.fix: Clamp indices to `engine.text(entity, component).length`; use `defineTextComponent` for CRDT text.

errors.summary: The document archive has an unsupported format or version.
errors.fix: Migrate the archive with the matching engine version before restoring it.

errors.summary: A CRDT update could not be decoded or applied.
errors.fix: Only feed bytes produced by `encodeUpdate()` / `onLocalUpdate()` of a compatible engine; request a full resync.

errors.summary: The collaboration session is closed.
errors.fix: Re-join the room; the engine resyncs with its state vector on reconnect.

errors.summary: A feature UI was mounted while its logic was not activated (I-5).
errors.fix: Call `featureHost.mount(id)` (it activates first) instead of mounting UI directly, or activate the feature before mounting.

errors.summary: A feature cannot deactivate while a dependent feature is mounted (I-6).
errors.fix: Unmount the dependent features first; the resource manager retries demotion once the ref-count drops to zero.

errors.summary: A feature module failed to load (the manifest's `load()` rejected).
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (network/chunk error). Activating again retries the load.

errors.summary: A feature's activation failed (activate(), restore() or a unit of the feature injector failed).
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Return a typed Result from activate(); activating again retries.

errors.summary: No feature with this id is registered in the feature host.
errors.fix: Register the manifest (`featureHost.register(manifest)` or contribute it to `FeatureManifestsToken`) before using it.

errors.summary: A feature this feature requires is not registered or could not be activated.
errors.fix: Register every feature listed in `requires.features`; check the dependency feature for its own failure.

errors.summary: Feature `requires.features` declarations form a cycle, or a feature id is registered twice.
errors.fix: Break the cycle by extracting the shared capability into a unit both features consume.

errors.summary: A feature's mount() failed; the feature stays activated (logic warm).
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`; mount() must only render — move fallible work into activate().

errors.summary: Persisting or reading a feature snapshot failed.
errors.fix: Check the ArchiveStore backend (quota, private mode). The feature falls back to a fresh activation.

errors.summary: A gate denied this resource (forbidden or upgrade required). Gated-out chunks are never fetched (I-8).
errors.fix: Check `gate.explain(level, id, action)` for the determining policy; show the denied/upsell state instead of loading the resource.

errors.summary: A gate denied this resource because the subject is not logged in.
errors.fix: Route through login (keep the deep link as `returnTo`); the decision re-evaluates when session facts change.

errors.summary: A meter does not cover the cost of this action.
errors.fix: Show the low-balance / upsell surface. The server balance is authoritative; refresh it with `meter.setServerState()`.

errors.summary: A rate meter is exhausted for the current window.
errors.fix: Wait until the window resets (`details.retryAt`); do not retry in a loop.

errors.summary: The resource is unavailable on this platform, host, region or configuration.
errors.fix: Hide the entry point; check platform/host facts in `gate.explain()`.

errors.summary: A policy (default or remote override) is malformed.
errors.fix: Fix the policy JSON: see `details.path`. Remote overrides are rejected as a whole; the previous table stays active.

errors.summary: Two policies in the same layer share an id.
errors.fix: Policy ids must be unique per layer (`pkg/name`). Use a remote override with the same id to replace a default.

errors.summary: The reservation is not in a state that allows this operation.
errors.fix: Only `reserved` reservations can be committed or released (docs/LIFECYCLES.md §11). Check `reservation.state` first.

errors.summary: The meter is not registered.
errors.fix: Register the meter definition (MeterDefinitionsToken) before reserving against it.

errors.summary: Stored data is not a valid snapshot envelope.
errors.fix: The entry was written by something else or is corrupted; it is discarded. Write entries only through the handoff store / createEnvelope().

errors.summary: A snapshot envelope belongs to a different key.
errors.fix: Each slot key must map to exactly one storage key; check for two slots sharing a key.

errors.summary: A snapshot envelope has a version that cannot be migrated to the expected version.
errors.fix: Add a migration for every version step (`migrations: { 1: v1 => v2 }`); envelopes from newer app versions are discarded.

errors.summary: A snapshot envelope has expired.
errors.fix: Expected for TTL entries; write a fresh entry or raise the TTL with a reason.

errors.summary: A snapshot payload failed schema validation.
errors.fix: The payload shape changed without a version bump; bump `version` and add a migration.

errors.summary: The handoff storage rejected a read or write (quota, disabled storage, serialization).
errors.fix: Keep handoff payloads small (ids, not documents); large snapshots belong in an IndexedDB-backed storage.

errors.summary: Two different handoff slots use the same key.
errors.fix: Slot keys are namespaced by package (`studio/…`); rename one, or share the single slot declaration.

errors.summary: The login redirect came back with a state that does not match the stored one.
errors.fix: Start a fresh login; never resume carried state for a redirect this tab did not start.

errors.summary: The login return target is not a same-origin path.
errors.fix: Pass a path starting with a single "/" (e.g. `/studio/doc/42`), never an absolute or protocol-relative URL.

errors.summary: A slot carried through a redirect uses the `memory` scope, which does not survive the redirect.
errors.fix: Declare carried slots with `scope: "tab"` (or `"origin"` when login opens in another tab).

errors.summary: An island marker is malformed (missing/invalid chunk id or unknown hydrate strategy).
errors.fix: Emit markers with `renderIslandMarker()`; `chunk` must be a logical chunk id (`feature:x`) and `hydrate` one of visible|idle|interaction|eager|never.

errors.summary: Island props could not be parsed or failed the island module's props validation.
errors.fix: Serialize props with `serializeIslandProps()` at prerender time and keep the island module's `props` schema in sync with what the prerender step emits.

errors.summary: An island was not hydrated because the gate (or the chunk gate/profile check) denied its chunk.
errors.fix: Expected for gated features: the island keeps its static markup. Call `handle.retry()` after the gate decision changes (e.g. after login).

errors.summary: The island's chunk failed to load.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (a `SF-LOAD-*` error). The static markup stays; call `handle.retry()` (e.g. when back online).

errors.summary: The island chunk does not export the island contract (`hydrate(element, context)`).
errors.fix: Export `hydrate` (or `export default defineIsland({ hydrate })`) from the chunk entry; with `export="name"` the named export must be an island module.

errors.summary: The island module's `hydrate()` threw or returned an error.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. `hydrate` must attach behaviour to the existing DOM; queued user events are dropped when it fails.

errors.summary: An island changed size during hydration, or its static markup does not match its declared size (layout shift risk, R12.19).
errors.fix: Make the prerendered markup size-stable: render the same box server-side, declare `size="WxH"` matching it, and avoid inserting/removing content in `hydrate()`.

errors.summary: An island declared `hydrate="eager"` without a `reason`; it was downgraded to `idle` (R12.12).
errors.fix: Add `reason="…"` (`data-sf-reason`) explaining why it must hydrate during boot, or use visible/idle/interaction.

errors.summary: A persisted snapshot has a version with no migration path to the current version; it was dropped.
errors.fix: Expected after deploys that change a store schema. Add a migration (`migrations[fromVersion]`) to keep users' state across the change.

errors.summary: A snapshot bound to another identity was found; it was dropped and not restored.
errors.fix: Expected after an account switch. Call `registry.clearIdentityBound()` on logout so other identities never see stale snapshots.

errors.summary: A snapshot exceeded its byte budget; it was not saved (and the previous one was removed).
errors.fix: Snapshot less (select the visible slice in `capture`) or raise `maxBytes` with a reason; large state belongs in an archive, not the boot snapshot.

errors.summary: A persisted snapshot envelope is malformed; it was dropped.
errors.fix: Usually written by an older/foreign build. Nothing to do; if it repeats, check that only the snapshot registry writes under its key prefix.

errors.summary: A snapshot could not be applied (schema validation or store header mismatch); it was dropped.
errors.fix: Bump the store/source version when the shape changes and add a migration; never change a schema without bumping its version.

errors.summary: The snapshot store failed to read or write.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (`SF-STORE-*`). Boot continues without snapshots; bind a working AsyncStore to `SnapshotStoreToken`.

errors.summary: Two snapshot sources were registered with the same id.
errors.fix: Give each snapshot source a unique id (normally the store id).

errors.summary: Restoring snapshots exceeded its time box; boot continued without them.
errors.fix: The snapshot store is slow (cold IndexedDB). Keep snapshots small, or raise `restoreTimeoutMs` with a reason.

errors.summary: No snapshot source is registered with this id.
errors.fix: Register the source (`registry.register(source)` or a `SnapshotSourcesToken` contribution) before restoring it.

errors.summary: Island props contain values that are not plain JSON data (functions, symbols, bigint, cycles, class instances, non-finite numbers).
errors.fix: Pass only plain data as island props; derive everything else inside `hydrate()`.

errors.summary: An ICU message has a syntax error.
errors.fix: Check braces and the `other` branch of plural/select args; quote literal braces as `'{'`. Run `checkCatalogs()` to list every broken message.

errors.summary: A message was formatted without one of its placeholders.
errors.fix: Pass every placeholder the message uses; the params type of `t(ref, params)` lists them.

errors.summary: A locale catalog failed to load.
errors.fix: Check the catalog loader for this namespace/locale (chunk URL, network). The source-locale text is shown meanwhile.

errors.summary: The requested locale is not a valid BCP 47 tag.
errors.fix: Pass a well-formed tag such as `fr`, `pt-BR` or `zh-Hant-TW`.

errors.summary: The logical chunk id is not in the build manifest.
errors.fix: Declare the chunk with `chunk(id, …)`, list it in the build plugin declarations and rebuild; check for a stale `sf-manifest.json`.

errors.summary: The chunk gate denied this chunk; nothing was fetched (I-8).
errors.fix: Expected for gated-out features: render the upsell/unavailable surface instead. The gate (`canLoad`) decides; do not bypass it.

errors.summary: A chunk failed to load after retries.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (404 after deploy → reload with the new manifest; CORS/CORP → check the isolation policy `crossorigin`).

errors.summary: A federated remote requires a shared singleton version the host does not provide.
errors.fix: Align the remote build with the host singleton versions (P9: one version per app), or widen the remote `requiredVersion` range with a reason.

errors.summary: A federated remote container could not be loaded or does not expose the module.
errors.fix: Check the remote entry URL in the manifest (`remote.entry`) and the exposed module name (`remote.module`).

errors.summary: A chunk declared `load: 'eager'` without a reason (R12.12).
errors.fix: Add `reason: '…'` to the declaration, or drop `load: 'eager'` (everything is lazy by default).

errors.summary: The build manifest is malformed or has an unsupported format version.
errors.fix: Regenerate `sf-manifest.json` with `createManifest()` from the same @staticflux/loader version the app runs.

errors.summary: The chunk is scoped to other app profiles; code for other modes is never fetched (R12.10).
errors.fix: Bind a per-mode variant feature for this profile (R18.5) instead of loading the other mode's chunk.

errors.summary: No boot plan matches the current app profile.
errors.fix: Add a fallback boot plan without a `match` (it matches every profile), or a plan whose `match` covers this profile.

errors.summary: The bundler output does not contain an entry for a declared chunk, or a declared dependency is unknown.
errors.fix: Make sure each declaration's `entry` matches a bundler entry/dynamic-import module (or chunk name), and every `deps` id is declared.

errors.summary: Import maps are unsupported here, or a module script ran before the import map was installed.
errors.fix: Use the dynamic-import strategy as fallback (the default), or install the import map before any module script.

errors.summary: This browser exposes no WebMCP model context (navigator.modelContext / document.modelContext).
errors.fix: Expected outside Chrome with the WebMCP flag/origin trial. Agents fall back to other channels; nothing to fix in app code.

errors.summary: The browser rejected a WebMCP tool registration.
errors.fix: Usually a duplicate tool name or invalid schema (see `cause`). Tool names derive from capability ids, which must be unique.

errors.summary: The WebMCP publisher was disposed; its tools are no longer registered.
errors.fix: Expected when the owning scope ends. Agents must re-list tools.

errors.summary: A surface was requested for a scope that is already disposed, or for an owner that lives longer than the surface’s declared scope (I-7).
errors.fix: Request surfaces with the owning scope of the page/feature/view that shows them (e.g. `ownerOf(featureInjector)`); a surface declared `scope: "view"` cannot be owned by the app scope.

errors.summary: The surface is gated out for this user (its upsell surface, if declared, was shown instead).
errors.fix: Expected for premium surfaces. Check the gate decision in devtools; declare `upsell` on the surface to resolve denials to an upsell.

errors.summary: No routable dialog surface is registered for this key.
errors.fix: Declare the dialog with `defineSurface({ kind: "dialog", routable: { key } })` and register it (RoutableSurfacesToken contribution or `bridge.register`).

errors.summary: The routable dialog parameters failed to parse.
errors.fix: Fix the URL producer, or make `routable.params` accept the given shape and return a typed error otherwise.

errors.summary: The coach mark target never became available (registered and visible) before the timeout.
errors.fix: Mark the target with `coachTarget(target)` in its template, or raise `targetTimeoutMs`; coach marks never show without their target.

errors.summary: Two routable surfaces were registered with the same key.
errors.fix: Routable dialog keys are app-unique: rename one of them.

errors.summary: The routable dialog’s lazy content failed to load.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (chunk load/network). The dialog was not entered; the router should keep the parent path.

errors.summary: No route matches the requested location.
errors.fix: Register a route for this path (RoutesToken contribution), or pass `notFound` to the router config.

errors.summary: A stage plugin or route guard blocked the navigation.
errors.fix: Inspect `details.stage` / `details.step`; guards should pass a specific SfError to `block(error)`.

errors.summary: Too many redirects in one navigation.
errors.fix: Two guards redirect to each other. Make one of them `continue` for the other route, or raise `maxRedirects` with a reason.

errors.summary: A stage step threw or returned an error result.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Stage plugins return `block(error)` for expected denials; `err()` and throws mean "failed".

errors.summary: No candidate feature of the route capability is available for the current app profile.
errors.fix: Add a feature variant for this mode to the route `feature` selector (R18.5/R18.7), or gate the route for this profile.

errors.summary: A transient route finished its transient stage without redirecting.
errors.fix: Transient routes never commit: give the route a `redirect`, or contribute a `transient` stage plugin that redirects.

errors.summary: The route/dialog/stage definitions are invalid (duplicate id or path, unregistered parent, bad key or position).
errors.fix: Read `details`; ids and full paths are unique, parents must be registered, dialog keys are `[a-z0-9-]+`.

errors.summary: The dialog cannot be opened here: unknown key, or its owner route is not part of the current route.
errors.fix: Feature-level dialogs open only below their `owner` route (R7.16); app-level dialogs have no owner.

errors.summary: A routable dialog was requested but no DialogSurfacePort is bound.
errors.fix: Register the messaging package (it binds DialogSurfacePortToken), or bind your own port.

errors.summary: Activating or mounting the route feature failed.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (runtime SF-FT-* error); the feature host owns the feature lifecycle.

errors.summary: A path parameter required by the route pattern is missing or empty.
errors.fix: Pass every `:param` of the route path in `params` (the types require them; this is a runtime guard for untyped callers).

errors.summary: The router was disposed.
errors.fix: Expected during app shutdown or reinitialize. Do not keep router references beyond the app scope.

errors.summary: A stage plugin attaches to a custom stage that is not registered.
errors.fix: Contribute the stage (CustomStagesToken / `stages` option) created by `defineStage`, or attach the plugin to a built-in stage.

errors.summary: A layout read happened after a DOM write in the same frame (forced synchronous layout).
errors.fix: Move the read into `scheduler.measure()` and the write into `scheduler.mutate()` (R12.15); never interleave reads and writes.

errors.summary: A feature mark exceeded its runtime budget.
errors.fix: Open the journey trace: the phase critical path names the slow span (chunk, unit init, resource). Defer it or make it cheaper; raising a budget needs a reviewed reason (R12.8).

errors.summary: A component re-rendered too often within a short window (render storm).
errors.fix: Read fewer observables in render, batch updates (`batch()`), or move derived values into `derived()` (R12.14).

errors.summary: A feature subtree shifted layout (placeholder size differs from content, or shift score over threshold).
errors.fix: Give the placeholder the final size (size-stable skeletons, R12.19) or reserve space with CSS `contain-intrinsic-size`/aspect-ratio.

errors.summary: A long animation frame / long task exceeded the frame budget.
errors.fix: Chunk the work with `yieldToMain()` or move it to a worker (R12.18); the violation names the chunk/feature from LoAF script attribution.

errors.summary: New conformance violations were found compared to the baseline.
errors.fix: Fix the listed violations (each carries its own code and fix); only update the baseline for accepted, reviewed exceptions.

errors.summary: Input-to-next-paint latency exceeded its budget.
errors.fix: Keep event handlers short: update state, let the scheduler render, and defer non-visual work (`postTask("idle")`).

errors.summary: The violation baseline is malformed or has an unsupported format.
errors.fix: Regenerate it with `collector.baseline()` (format `sf-violations/1`).

errors.summary: A forced host mode or form factor is not registered.
errors.fix: Use one of the registered ids (see `profile.hostModes` / `profile.formFactors`), or register the host mode / form factor plugin first.

errors.summary: Two host mode definitions use the same id.
errors.fix: Give each `defineHostMode({ id })` a unique id; to replace a built-in, leave the built-in out of the host mode list.

errors.summary: Probing built-in AI availability failed or timed out.
errors.fix: Treat AI as unavailable for now; call `facts.probeAi()` again later (e.g. after the model download finishes).

errors.summary: The current host mode does not provide a host bridge.
errors.fix: Only embedded/webview host modes have bridges. Gate the feature on `profile.hostMode.bridge !== undefined`, or add `bridge` to the host mode definition.

errors.summary: The host bridge failed to load.
errors.fix: Check the bridge chunk and the host handshake; the app should continue in degraded mode without host features.

errors.summary: Service workers are not available here (unsupported browser, insecure context, or an embedded host mode).
errors.fix: Expected in embedded/webview modes and on http://; the app keeps working without offline support. Gate PWA-only features on `updater.supported`.

errors.summary: Registering the service worker failed.
errors.fix: Check that the SW script URL is same-origin, served with a JavaScript MIME type, and inside the requested scope (or send `Service-Worker-Allowed`).

errors.summary: Precaching the critical tier failed; the new service worker was not installed (the previous version stays active).
errors.fix: Check that every critical-tier file in sf-manifest.json is deployed and returns 200; the browser retries the install on the next update check.

errors.summary: The waiting service worker did not take control in time after skipWaiting.
errors.fix: Make sure the SW runtime handles the `sf-pwa/skip-waiting` message (createServiceWorkerRuntime does); the update is retried on the next check.

errors.summary: accept() was called but no updated service worker is waiting.
errors.fix: Only call accept() while `updater.state === "available"` (after the update-available event).

errors.summary: Reinitializing the app after a service worker update failed; the page was reloaded instead.
errors.fix: Inspect the cause from the runtime supervisor; subsystems must tolerate `reinitialize` (stop → start).

errors.summary: The web app manifest declaration is invalid.
errors.fix: Fix the field named in `details.field` (see https://www.w3.org/TR/appmanifest/); URLs must stay within `scope`.

errors.summary: A non-idempotent mutation cannot be queued for background replay.
errors.fix: Only declare `idempotent: true` for requests that are safe to repeat (PUT/DELETE with an idempotency key); other mutations must fail while offline (R4.6).

errors.summary: The page is still not cross-origin isolated after the COOP/COEP service worker reload.
errors.fix: The host or a browser extension strips the headers, the page was hard-reloaded (bypasses the SW), or the page is embedded. Serve COOP/COEP from the host, or use `isolation: "preferred"`.

errors.summary: The service worker did not answer a message in time.
errors.fix: Check that the active SW was built with createServiceWorkerRuntime and the matching plugin; the caller falls back to the non-SW path.

errors.summary: The shared payload referenced by the URL was not found (already consumed or expired).
errors.fix: Share payloads are consume-once; re-share from the source app.

errors.summary: The frame scheduler was disposed; the job was dropped.
errors.fix: Expected during shutdown. Do not schedule work on a disposed scheduler.

errors.summary: No workspace with this id is registered.
errors.fix: Declare it with `defineWorkspace({ id })` and contribute it (`workspaceContribution(def)`) or pass it to `createWorkspaceManager`.

errors.summary: The workspace is gated out for this user.
errors.fix: Expected for premium/expert workspaces. Check the gate decision; offer the upsell instead of switching.

errors.summary: No command with this id is registered.
errors.fix: Contribute the command (`commandContribution(defineCommand({ id, … }))`) from the feature that owns it.

errors.summary: The command is not available right now (its `when` is false or it is gated out).
errors.fix: Check `registry.available(id)` before running; palettes only list available commands.

errors.summary: The command threw while running.
errors.fix: Commands return a `Result`; wrap fallible work and return a typed error instead of throwing.

errors.summary: Two shell contributions (slot contributions, commands or workspaces) share an id.
errors.fix: Ids are app-unique (`<package>/<name>`); rename one of them.

errors.summary: The storage quota or a configured budget was exceeded; the write was rejected.
errors.fix: Store less (ids instead of documents, trim history), purge expired entries (`purgeExpired()`), or move large values to IndexedDB/OPFS. Raise a `withBudget` limit only with a documented reason.

errors.summary: The storage backend is not available in this environment.
errors.fix: Feature-detected (Safari private mode, sandboxed iframes, disabled cookies, missing OPFS). Use `fallback([...])` or `detectLocalStore()` so the app degrades to memory and reports it.

errors.summary: A stored value could not be decoded (bad JSON, wrong envelope, failed decryption or failed migration).
errors.fix: The entry was written by something else, by an older/newer format, or with a different key. Delete it, or add a migration to the envelope codec.

errors.summary: The storage operation was aborted.
errors.fix: Usually expected (scope disposal, navigation). Do not retry aborted work.

errors.summary: The backend does not support this operation or option.
errors.fix: Check `store.capabilities` first; wrap the store with the middleware that adds the feature (e.g. `withTtl()` for `ttlMs`).

errors.summary: Invalid key or value: keys are non-empty strings and values must be defined and structured-clone-safe.
errors.fix: Use `delete(key)` instead of storing `undefined`; store plain data (no functions, DOM nodes or class instances).

errors.summary: The store was used after `dispose()`.
errors.fix: Create stores in the owning scope and stop using them once the scope is disposed.

errors.summary: The storage backend rejected a read or write.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` and `details.backend`/`details.op`. Transient failures can be retried by the caller; persistent ones should degrade via `fallback([...])`.

errors.summary: The canvas could not provide a rendering context of the requested kind.
errors.fix: Feature-detect the kind (`supportsSurfaceKind`) and declare a fallback kind (e.g. webgpu → webgl → canvas2d).

errors.summary: OffscreenCanvas transfer is not available, so the surface cannot render in a worker.
errors.fix: Use `createRenderSurface` (falls back to a main-thread surface automatically) or render on the main thread.

errors.summary: The render engine failed to initialize.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`; engines must return a Result from `init(ctx)` and degrade (e.g. WebGPU adapter missing → report, let the app pick another kind).

errors.summary: This API needs the DOM (main thread) but was used where no document exists (e.g. in a worker).
errors.fix: Create HTML-in-Canvas adapters and accessible layers on the main thread; render heavy 3D in the render worker (hybrid composition).

errors.summary: A cross-origin image would taint the canvas: the response is opaque (no CORS).
errors.fix: Serve the image with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` (and `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` when isolated), or proxy it same-origin.

errors.summary: An image for a surface could not be loaded or decoded.
errors.fix: Check the URL and the CORS headers; decoding failures usually mean an unsupported format.

errors.summary: The render worker reported an error or did not answer.
errors.fix: Check the worker registers the engine id with `hostRenderSurfaces({ engines })`; worker crashes are handled by its supervisor.

errors.summary: A surface exceeded its frame-time or input-latency budget.
errors.fix: Profile the engine frame (`surface/frame-time`); move work to the render worker or reduce per-frame work; raise the budget only with a reason.

errors.summary: The surface is not attached (or was disposed).
errors.fix: Call `attach(host)` first and wait for it; check `surface.state` before starting the frame loop.

errors.summary: `bootTestApp` could not boot the app.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause` (usually a missing provider or a failing critical unit) and add the unit or an override.

errors.summary: A token requested through a testkit helper did not resolve.
errors.fix: Register a unit (or an override) that provides the token; see `cause` for the injector error.

errors.summary: The code under test emitted conformance `violation` events.
errors.fix: Fix the reported violations (each carries a code and a fix), or assert them explicitly with `violations()`.

errors.summary: `runAll` exceeded its iteration limit (a timer keeps rescheduling itself).
errors.fix: Use `advance(ms)` for intervals and self-rescheduling timers, or raise `limit` with a reason.

errors.summary: A span structure assertion failed.
errors.fix: Compare against `formatSpanTree()` output; check the `parent` option where the child span is started.

errors.summary: A module given to `sf` could not be imported.
errors.fix: Build the package first (`pnpm build`) and pass a path to an ES module (.js/.mjs) relative to the working directory.

errors.summary: The graph entry module does not export a valid `units` array.
errors.fix: Export `units` (an array of `unit({...})` declarations) or `module` (a `defineModule({...})` result); optional `external` is an array of tokens or token ids.

errors.summary: A file needed by `sf` could not be read.
errors.fix: Check the path (relative paths resolve against the working directory) and that the file exists.

errors.summary: A JSON file needed by `sf` could not be parsed or has the wrong shape.
errors.fix: Fix the JSON syntax; `.size-limit.json` must be an array of `{ name, path, limit }` and size-limit results an array of `{ name, size }` (`size-limit --json`).

errors.summary: Unknown `sf` command or invalid arguments.
errors.fix: Run `sf help` for the list of commands and their flags.

errors.summary: Two error definitions share a code but differ in kind, summary or fix.
errors.fix: Give each `defineError` call a unique `SF-<AREA>-NNN` code; codes are stable identifiers and must never be reused.

errors.summary: A render dependency was read before it was ready (I-11).
errors.fix: Read render deps only inside `render()` (which runs after readiness) or after `this.ready`; use a `lazy` dep for values that may arrive later.

errors.summary: A component connected without an injector scope above it in the DOM.
errors.fix: Render the component inside an `<sf-scope>` (the app root passes `.injector`) or call `provideScope(rootElement, …)` first.

errors.summary: A render dependency (or a blocking hook) failed, so the component cannot render its content.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Make the dependency `lazy` if the component can render without it, or add a `failed` template to the component spec.

errors.summary: A component class was defined without a valid spec (missing `static spec`, invalid tag, or tag already taken by another class).
errors.fix: Declare `static override readonly spec = component({ tag: "x-y", … })` on the class and call `defineComponent(Class)` once.

errors.summary: A component dependency hook failed.
errors.fix: Inspect `cause`. Non-blocking hook failures are reported only; blocking ones keep the component in its failed state.

errors.summary: A component's render() threw.
errors.fix: render() must be pure: read state, return a template. Move fallible work to hooks or store actions returning Result.

errors.summary: A hook or intent referenced a dependency key the component did not declare.
errors.fix: Use one of the keys declared in `component({ deps })`; the types list them.

errors.summary: An intent from the URL tried to auto-execute, but its policy is prefill-only.
errors.fix: Use the intent to prefill UI and let the user confirm. Mark the intent `safe: true` only for side-effect-free actions (e.g. opening a panel), after review.

errors.summary: Two URL declarations use the same query key.
errors.fix: Query keys are a shared namespace: rename one (prefix with the package, e.g. `chat-prompt`) or reuse the single declaration.

errors.summary: A URL parameter value could not be parsed by its codec.
errors.fix: Expected for hand-edited URLs: the default value is used and the bad parameter is removed. Check links that generate this URL.

errors.summary: A dialog path is malformed or contains more than one routable dialog.
errors.fix: Use `<feature-path>/d/<key>` or `/d/<key>` with a kebab-case key; stack further dialogs as non-routable surfaces.

errors.summary: This URL part kind cannot be bound by the URL-sync service.
errors.fix: Only `view` and `sticky` params sync to stores; `path` belongs to the router, `dialog` to messaging, `intent` to the intent service and `hidden` to handoff.

errors.summary: WebAssembly is not available in this environment.
errors.fix: Gate the feature on the `wasm/features` fact (`supported`) and provide a JS fallback implementation.

errors.summary: No variant of the Wasm module can run here: a required Wasm feature is missing.
errors.fix: Add a variant without the feature (e.g. a scalar build next to the SIMD build), or move the feature to `features.optional` and check `context.features` in the imports factory.

errors.summary: The Wasm module needs threads (shared memory), but the page is not cross-origin isolated.
errors.fix: Serve COOP `same-origin` + COEP `require-corp`/`credentialless` (isolation: "required"), or declare a non-threaded variant so the module degrades automatically (embedded hosts are never isolated).

errors.summary: The Wasm binary could not be fetched.
errors.fix: Check the chunk/URL (404 after deploy → reload with the new manifest) and, when isolated, that the response carries CORP/CORS headers.

errors.summary: The Wasm binary failed to compile.
errors.fix: Rebuild the module; check that the variant matches its declared features (a SIMD build loaded as the scalar variant fails here).

errors.summary: The Wasm module failed to instantiate (missing/mismatched imports or start function trapped).
errors.fix: Make the `imports` factory provide every import the module declares (see `details.imports`), with matching signatures.

errors.summary: A Wasm module was instantiated on the main thread without `allowMainThread`.
errors.fix: Host the module in a worker (register its unit in the worker injector), or declare `allowMainThread: { reason, budgetMs }` for tiny synchronous work.

errors.summary: The Wasm module is not instantiated yet (or was disposed).
errors.fix: Resolve the module through its unit (ready = instantiated) or await `handle.load()` before touching exports.

errors.summary: The Wasm module does not export a declared export.
errors.fix: Check the `exports` list against the module (`WebAssembly.Module.exports`); rebuild with the export enabled.

errors.summary: A memory view is out of bounds or the module exports no memory.
errors.fix: Export the memory (`memory`) or name it with `memoryExport`; allocate inside Wasm and pass the pointer; re-acquire views after memory growth (or use `liveView`).

errors.summary: A Wasm module exceeded its declared budget (binary size, compile time or main-thread call time).
errors.fix: Shrink the module (wasm-opt -Oz, strip debug info), split it, or raise the budget with a documented reason.

errors.summary: A message on a worker port is not a valid envelope, or its payload fails the protocol schema.
errors.fix: Send messages only through a Link / protocol client; check the schema of the channel and message named in `details`.

errors.summary: A replica was written to directly. Replicas are read-only; writes must be sent as intents to the owner (I-9).
errors.fix: Send the write as an intent (e.g. `replica.intent(action, args)` or a store created with an intent `sink`); the owner applies it and replicates the patches back.

errors.summary: The worker did not complete the handshake in time.
errors.fix: Check that the worker script loads and calls `runWorker()`; raise `handshakeTimeoutMs` only with a documented reason.

errors.summary: The worker crashed while a non-idempotent request was in flight; the request was not retried.
errors.fix: Declare the request `idempotent: true` in its protocol if a retry is safe, or re-check state and retry explicitly.

errors.summary: The worker exceeded its restart intensity and was given up; its declared fallback is active.
errors.fix: Inspect the crash causes (`worker/supervisor` telemetry). The app stays degraded until `restart()` succeeds.

errors.summary: A cross-thread request was not answered in time.
errors.fix: Make the handler cheaper or stream partial results via events; raise `timeoutMs` only with a documented reason.

errors.summary: Replication epoch or version mismatch; the replica must resnapshot.
errors.fix: Usually self-healing (the replica re-handshakes). If it repeats, check that one owner publishes the store.

errors.summary: No handler is registered on the other side for this channel or message.
errors.fix: Register the handler (`runWorker({ handlers })`, `server.handle()`, `publisher.attach()`) before the peer sends to it.

errors.summary: The link was closed before the message was answered.
errors.fix: Expected during respawn/shutdown. Supervised requests marked idempotent are retried automatically.

errors.summary: The worker is not running (draining or terminated); the request was rejected.
errors.fix: Call `start()` first, or check `worker.state` before sending requests.

errors.summary: The token broker refused the brokered call.
errors.fix: Only call operations the broker allows; never send credentials from a worker — the owning side attaches them.

errors.summary: A core context contained raw credentials; they were stripped before replication (R11.7).
errors.fix: Remove tokens from the context value (use the token broker), or declare `allowSecrets: true` with a reviewed reason.

errors.summary: The requested worker kind is not available in this environment.
errors.fix: Provide a fallback spawner (e.g. dedicated worker or in-thread) — SharedWorker and module workers are not universal.

errors.summary: The owner does not know the requested intent action.
errors.fix: Check the intent name against the replica definition; owners must handle every declared intent.

errors.summary: The worker could not be spawned.
errors.fix: Check the worker URL/bundle and CSP `worker-src`; the supervisor retries with backoff up to its restart intensity.

errors.summary: A patch could not be applied (bad path or operation).
errors.fix: Patches must use paths that exist in the snapshot; a replica that hits this resnapshots automatically.

errors.summary: The worker missed too many heartbeats and was treated as crashed.
errors.fix: Move long synchronous work off the message loop (chunk it and yield); heartbeats need the loop to turn.

errors.summary: The worker speaks a different protocol (id or version) than the supervisor.
errors.fix: Deploy the worker bundle together with the main bundle; bump protocol versions on breaking changes.

errors.summary: The tab coordinator was stopped (disposed) before the operation completed.
errors.fix: Expected during shutdown. Create calls from a scope that outlives the coordinator, or check `coordinator.role !== "stopped"`.

errors.summary: The tab coordinator does not own a resource with this replica definition.
errors.fix: Add an `ownedResource(definition, create)` for it to `createTabCoordinator({ owned })` (and to the SharedWorker host).

errors.summary: The requested coordinator transport is not available (no SharedWorker, or it failed to connect).
errors.fix: Use `transport: 'auto'` so the coordinator falls back to Web Locks leader election over BroadcastChannel.

errors.summary: A cross-tab message from an older leadership term was dropped.
errors.fix: Usually self-healing (the sender learns the new term and re-handshakes). If it repeats, check that every tab runs the same coordinator id.
